title: WANMAI static-verification manifest and re-derivation script
description: SHA-256 manifest and counting script supporting a two-timepoint source-code verification of a cleft-care information system (BMC MIDM manuscript in preparation). Contains file names, hashes and counts only: no source code, credentials or patient data. Snapshot generated 2026-11-23; the T1 (2026-08-06) state was not preserved.
